context: Two friends chat at the cafe
purpose: Teach: カーペット/バイブル/粥/開封/迷路/曲がる/下校/高血圧

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、カーペット、絶対、新しくしたわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Aoi, you really did refresh the carpet in the shop, didn't you? I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, admiring opening. Light lift on the compliment. Genuine interest in what she notices. Conversational ease — she's speaking to someone she's comfortable with.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お祖父さまの教えを、本気で、絶対、バイブル、絶対、と、絶対、葵、絶対、考えているわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. My grandfather's teachings are kind of like my bible, you know? I take them seriously.
lines.style: Thoughtful, grounded tone. Slight pause before the comparison, like she's choosing her words carefully. Sincere without being heavy. A quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、お粥、絶対、メニュー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、頼みたいわ
lines.en: I'd really like to try the rice porridge on your menu sometime.
lines.style: Soft eagerness. Genuine interest without pressure. The tone of someone who notices the care Aoi puts into what she serves. Slightly hopeful lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 業務用の、本気で、絶対、コーヒー、絶対、葵、絶対、慎重に、絶対、開封、絶対、しているの、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm careful about how I handle the commercial-grade coffee when I open it. Those containers are heavy.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical. No fuss. A small detail that shows her attention to the work. Straightforward delivery — she's just explaining her process, not seeking praise.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅近くの、本気で、絶対、地下街、絶対、迷路、絶対、みたいよね、葵、メイちゃん
lines.en: The underground arcade near the station is like a maze, isn't it? You'd never find your way the first time.
lines.style: Reflective, observant tone. Light amusement in her voice. Speaking from experience — she knows the area, maybe has gotten lost there herself. Conversational, almost thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、駅から、絶対、二回、絶対、曲がるの、メイちゃん
lines.en: My shop is just two turns away from the station, so it's not too hard to find once you know the way.
lines.style: Practical, slightly modest. She's explaining logistics, not boasting. Calm, clear directions in her voice. The tone of someone who's given these directions before and means to be helpful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 下校途中の、本気で、絶対、学生さん、絶対、葵によく来てくれるわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: A lot of students on their way home from school stop by. I'm really glad they come.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, genuine gratitude. No false brightness. She means what she's saying — those students matter to her. Steady, sincere delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお客様の中に、本気で、絶対、高血圧、絶対、気にされる方、絶対、いらっしゃるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, some of my regular customers are quite careful about their blood pressure, so I try to keep that in mind.
lines.style: Attentive, caring practicality. She's thinking about her customers' wellbeing, not in a showy way — just matter-of-fact responsibility. Clear and thoughtful.
